reply.arabic: مَا أَدْرِي، لَاكِن الجَوّ فِيهِ سَحَاب

reply.english: I don't know, but there are clouds.

dialogue.speaker: منى
dialogue.arabic: صباح الخير يا فهد، إيش الجو اليوم برأيك؟
dialogue.transliteration: Sabaa7 ilkheer ya Fahd, eesh iljaw ilyoom bra2yak?
dialogue.english: Good morning Fahd, what's the weather like today in your opinion?

dialogue.speaker: فهد
dialogue.arabic: صباح النور. الجو فيه سحاب شوي، بس ما حر
dialogue.transliteration: Sabaa7 innoor. iljaw fiihi sa7aab shway, bass ma 7arr
dialogue.english: Good morning. There are some clouds, but it's not hot.

dialogue.speaker: منى
dialogue.arabic: يعني تشتي برأيك؟
dialogue.transliteration: ya3ni tishti bra2yak?
dialogue.english: So you think it'll rain?

dialogue.speaker: فهد
dialogue.arabic: ما أدري، بس من الصبح فيه هوا كتير
dialogue.transliteration: ma adri, bass min iSSub7 fiihi hawa ktiir
dialogue.english: I don't know, but there's been a lot of wind since morning.

dialogue.speaker: منى
dialogue.arabic: أنا حاسة الجو أحر من إمبارح
dialogue.transliteration: ana 7assa iljaw a7arr min imbaare7
dialogue.english: I feel like it's hotter than yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: فهد
dialogue.arabic: لا، أنا أحس العكس، الجو صار أبرد شوي
dialogue.transliteration: la, ana a7ass il3aks, iljaw Saar abrad shway
dialogue.english: No, I feel the opposite, it's gotten a bit colder.

dialogue.speaker: منى
dialogue.arabic: المهم، شفت الشمس طالعة؟
dialogue.transliteration: ilmuhimm, shift ishshams Taal3a?
dialogue.english: Anyway, did you see the sun's out?

dialogue.speaker: فهد
dialogue.arabic: إيه، بس فيه سحاب يغطيها شوي
dialogue.transliteration: eeh, bass fiihi sa7aab yghaTTiiha shway
dialogue.english: Yes, but there are clouds covering it a bit.

dialogue.speaker: منى
dialogue.arabic: خذ معك شمسية على كل حال
dialogue.transliteration: khidh ma3ak shamsiyya 3ala kill 7aal
dialogue.english: Take an umbrella with you just in case.

dialogue.speaker: فهد
dialogue.arabic: حاضر، تمام إنك ذكرتيني
dialogue.transliteration: haDir, tamaam innik zakkartiini
dialogue.english: Ok, good you reminded me.

dialogue.speaker: منى
dialogue.arabic: الله يحفظك، شوفك بعدين
dialogue.transliteration: alla ya7faDak, shoofak ba3deen
dialogue.english: Take care, see you later.

response.english: Yes, a lot of wind since morning.

dialogue.english: Leia, what's your favorite season?

dialogue.speaker: ليا
dialogue.arabic: أنا بحب الربيع كتير، الجو يصير معتدل
dialogue.transliteration: ana ba7ibb irrabii3 ktiir, iljaw ysiir mu3tadil
dialogue.english: I really like spring, the weather becomes mild.

dialogue.arabic: أنا بالعكس، أحب الشتا لأنو جو حلو
dialogue.transliteration: ana bil3aks, a7ibb ishshita li2anno jaw 7ilw
dialogue.english: I'm the opposite, I like winter because the weather is nice.

dialogue.speaker: ليا
dialogue.arabic: بس الصيف بالحجاز حار واجد وطويل
dialogue.transliteration: bass iSSayf bilhijaaz 7arr waajid w Tawiil
dialogue.english: But summer in Hejaz is very hot and long.

dialogue.arabic: إيه صح، بس على الأقل ما فيه شتي
dialogue.transliteration: eeh Sa7, bass 3ala al2a2ill ma fiihi shti
dialogue.english: Yeah true, but at least there's no rain.

dialogue.transliteration: ana ma ba7ibb ishshita khaliS, ysiir barid ktiir
dialogue.english: I don't like winter at all, it gets very cold.

dialogue.transliteration: ilkhariif 7ilw, wara2 ishshajar yTii7
dialogue.english: Fall is nice, the leaves fall.

dialogue.transliteration: eeh, w rii7it ishshiti birrabii3 7ilwa jiddan
dialogue.english: Yes, and the smell of rain in spring is really nice.

dialogue.english: Every season has its own beauty and needs.

dialogue.arabic: صح الكلام، بس أنا أفضل الطقس المعتدل
dialogue.transliteration: Sa7 ilkalam, bass ana afdDal iTTa2s ilmu3tadil

challenge.title: إِنْشَاء حِوَار عَن الْجَوّ
challenge.instructions: أَكْتُبْ حِوَار قَصِير (٤ إِلَى ٦ جُمَل) عَنْ الْجَوّ وَالْمَلَابِس. اسْتَخْدِمْ عَلَى الْأَقَلّ كَلِمَتَيْنِ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْقَائِمَة: "إِيشْ"، "حِلْو"، "بَرِد"، "شِتِي"، "لازِم". تَخَيَّلْ حِوَاراً بَيْنَ شَخْصَيْنِ يَتَحَدَّثَانِ عَنْ الْعِنَايَة بِالْجَسَد عِنْدَ تَغَيُّر الْجَوّ.

dialogue.speaker: علي
dialogue.arabic: صباح الخير يا فاطمة
dialogue.transliteration: Sabaa7 ilkheer ya Fatima
dialogue.english: Good morning Fatima

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: صباح النور. إيش الجو اليوم برأيك؟
dialogue.transliteration: Sabaa7 innoor. eesh iljaw ilyoom bra2yak?
dialogue.english: Good morning. What's the weather like today?

dialogue.speaker: علي
dialogue.arabic: الجو فيه سحاب وبارد شوي، لازم تلبس كنزة
dialogue.transliteration: iljaw fiihi sa7aab w barid shway, lazim tilbas kinza
dialogue.english: There are clouds and it's a bit cold, you need to wear a sweater.

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: إيه، وإذا شتي رح أخذ شمسية
dialogue.transliteration: eeh, w idha shti ra7 akhidh shamsiyya
dialogue.english: Yes, and if it rains I'll take an umbrella.

dialogue.speaker: علي
dialogue.arabic: حكمة، الله يحفظك
dialogue.transliteration: 7ikma, alla ya7faDak
dialogue.english: Smart, take care.
